players.product: Helios AI/HPC data-center campus (West Texas, 800 gross MW) leased to CoreWeave, plus Merlin / Caspian / Selene Texas development sites - ex-Bitcoin-mining site (Galaxy Power)

connects_to.relationship: Helios campus (West Texas) AI data-center capacity leased to CoreWeave - 800 gross MW across three phases (Phase I 133 MW critical IT delivered; Phase II 260 MW; Phase III 133 MW)

contracts.signal: Galaxy's Q2 2026 release summarizes the Helios CoreWeave leases (Phases I+II+III): 800MW gross power capacity and 526MW critical IT load, a 15-year base lease term excluding two 5-year extension options, Phase I rent commencement in Q2 2026, and anticipated average annual revenue of $1.2B+ with 90%+ anticipated average lease-level adjusted EBITDA margins, based on committed contractual terms and reflecting the full 526MW of contracted critical IT load over the lease term.
contracts.units: 526MW critical IT load / 800MW gross power (Phases I+II+III)
